scope: Determine whether BI5ResearchEngine.run() is an admissible production/research qualification path.

evidence_basis.source_of_truth: Verified local PR8 test worktree state, because the local worktree contains B08/B09 changes not yet present on the remote PR #8 head.

official_execution_path.binding: run_qualified_research() calls bind_execution_input(...) to create the sealed BoundResearchInput capability.
official_execution_path.engine_construction: run_qualified_research() passes the BoundResearchInput to BI5ResearchEngine(bound_input).
official_execution_path.monotonicity_invariant: BI5ResearchEngine.iter_ticks() enforces global timestamp monotonicity across the complete stream and raises on regression.

run_path_assessment.finding: The method exists as a generic public class method, but no evidence was found that it is called by the official qualification/research entrypoint.
run_path_assessment.reason: The official qualified execution path does not use run(); it uses iter_ticks(), where the global monotonicity invariant is enforced. The existence of a generic run() method without that invariant therefore does not constitute a current violation of the official qualification path.

generic_vs_official_rule.generic_public_path: BI5ResearchEngine.run() may exist for generic/internal use but is not an admissible qualification entrypoint by itself.
generic_vs_official_rule.official_qualification_path: Only the sealed binding path followed by the official execution flow using BI5ResearchEngine.iter_ticks() is admissible for the qualified research stream.
generic_vs_official_rule.entrypoint_gate: BI5ResearchEngine.run() MUST NOT be treated as an official qualification/research entrypoint unless a future qualification block explicitly audits and qualifies its complete invariants, including global tick-stream monotonicity.

closure_rule: Future production/research qualification code MUST enter through the qualified execution boundary. A direct call to BI5ResearchEngine.run() is not evidence of qualified execution and requires a new explicit qualification before it may be admitted as an official path.
final_reason: The only remaining B09 exposure was formally classified and closed. The official qualified execution path is proven to use iter_ticks(), which enforces global monotonicity. BI5ResearchEngine.run() is not an admissible qualification entrypoint without a future explicit qualification.
